Will the ETH you hold in your hands still be able to “earn interest” through staking in the future? 🤔

On August 5, six authors—including Justin Drake, a researcher at the Ethereum Foundation—dropped a major bombshell: the draft EIP-8361! This proposal, dubbed “Decreasing Issuance with Burn,” targets what it calls a “bug” in the current staking mechanism. Even if all ETH is staked, the annualized return still has a guaranteed floor of around 1.5%. The new proposal aims to wipe out that floor entirely!

The idea is simple: when the staking ratio reaches 50%, 100% of validator rewards would be burned, and the net staking yield would be reduced directly to zero ❗ To avoid spooking the market, the plan includes an 18-month transition period that gradually phases it in—but the direction has already ignited an uproar across the community.

Aave founder Stani fired the first shot. He argues that zero returns would push retail/home validators out first due to fixed operating costs, while non–return-driven giants—such as exchanges and ETF custodians—would stay put, potentially making staking more centralized ❓ He even warns that if taxes are applied to the full amount and the burned portion is treated as a capital loss, retail users could end up with the awkward situation of tax-after-losses.

Even more interesting: the draft was submitted just 48 hours before the deadline for EIP submissions ahead of the Hegotá upgrade. The community complains there’s “not enough time for review.” Is this a rescue mission for the network, or rule-making in a rush? 🤷

With half the supply locked down and yields set to zero, does Ethereum’s “earn-interest” narrative still hold water? Where should DeFi’s lending anchor go from here? See you in the comments! 👇

title: ETH守在1,872：下方7.78亿美元多单清算区，上方6.82亿美元空单清算区
subTitle:
ETH守在1,872：下方7.78亿美元多单清算区，上方6.82亿美元空单清算区

一张把价格夹在中间的清算地图

8月5日下午，币安公共行情显示ETH报1,872.65美元，BTC报64,172.08美元（快照时间16:00前后）。Coinglass给出的清算地图把ETH夹在中间：若跌破1,787美元，主流CEX累计多单清算强度将达7.78亿美元；若突破1,957美元，主流CEX累计空单清算强度将达6.82亿美元（ChainCatcher引述，8月5日）。现价距离两个触发价位各约85美元，幅度约4.5%，几乎对称。

清算强度衡量的是价格到达该价位时，按当前持仓分布估算会被强平的单边金额，数值会随仓位增减实时移动。ChainCatcher更早的快照里，同样的7.78亿美元多单清算强度对应的价位还是2,045美元，如今移动到1,787美元，说明这个数字是流动的，不是固定标尺。清算价之所以被市场反复讨论，是因为价格接近时强平单会自动执行，强平会推动价格继续朝清算方向移动，大额清算区会形成磁吸效应。

现货价格与永续合约的清算价存在联动：强平单通常在标记价格触发，杠杆仓在币安、OKX、Bybit等交易所的分布各不相同，Coinglass汇总的是主流CEX的累计值，不包含Hyperliquid等链上平台的仓位。把两侧数字放在一起看，下方7.78亿美元大于上方6.82亿美元，多头磁区绝对金额更大；但上方路径依赖放量突破，触发条件更苛刻。

价格与表现：主流币里偏弱的一个

多个行情来源的价格略有差异：Investing.com显示1,871.56美元，Bitget的24小时汇总报1,873美元并把ETH近7日跌幅记为1.84%，网易行情文章称ETH是当日唯一下跌的主流币，早间曾见1,864美元。差异来自快照时间，本文一并列出。与BTC（7日微涨）相比，ETH的反弹力度明显弱一档，过去一周从1,920美元附近回落后，在1,840–1,880美元区间反复震荡。

Gate广场多位交易员把1,890附近视为短期压力、1,850–1,860视为短期支撑，并提到当日成交较前几日萎缩（个人观点，非交易所数据）。另一份行情帖显示恐惧贪婪指数处于27，市场情绪仍在恐慌区间，山寨品种承压更明显。情绪指标与清算地图互相印证：波动区间收窄、成交萎缩的环境里，价格更容易被清算磁区牵引。

现货ETF：钱在流入，价格没涨

资金端没有延续下跌逻辑。Farside数据（BlockBeats引述，8月5日）显示，昨日美国现货比特币ETF净流入2.115亿美元，现货以太坊ETF净流入5,310万美元。Trader T的监测口径给出5,375万美元，其中贝莱德旗下ETHA净流入4,246万美元居首，富达FETH流入934万美元，Bitwise ETHW流入134万美元，摩根士丹利MSSE流入61万美元。两个来源相差几十万美元，属于统计截止时间差，方向一致。ETF持续净流入与ETH价格走弱并存，说明承接来自现货渠道，而抛压或对冲压力集中在合约和场内交易端。

SoSovalue的汇总口径与Farside基本吻合：周二美国BTC与ETH现货ETF合计净流入2.65亿美元，全品类无一净流出（Gate广场引述，8月5日）。三个来源的交叉验证说明，机构资金在ETF渠道确实是净流入状态，与场内价格的背离是当前ETH市场最明显的结构特征。

质押上限提案：供给叙事的变量

ETH质押量刚创下纪录：约4,140万枚ETH处于质押状态，占总供应约34%（BingX引述链上数据，8月3日），另有统计称7月28日质押比例达33.33%的历史新高（Bitmart引述）。两个口径相差不大，都指向同一个事实：质押率处于历史高位。

在此背景下，以太坊开发者提出一份草案（暂定EIP-8363）：当已质押ETH接近约6,025万枚时，递增燃烧共识奖励份额，把质押率目标限制在约50%；当前机制下收益率随验证者数量平方根下降，并保留约1.5%的底线。Gate新闻对草案的补充说明提到，奖励将在约18个月内逐步下降，草案不设硬上限，让市场自行把质押率稳定在50%以下。按当前约4,140万枚质押量估算，距离6,025万枚的触发阈值还有约1,900万枚的空间。

社区反馈不一：支持者认为发行会更紧缩、更可预测，反对者担心削弱独立验证者的激励。草案未定稿，没有生效时间表，属于影响ETH中期供给叙事的变量，对短期1,872美元的价格没有直接定价作用。

市场结构：资金正在流向山寨

CryptoQuant分析师Darkfost发文称，币安交易所山寨币交易量占比已升至约60%，比特币占22%，以太坊占18%，与5月比特币近40%主导交易的情况出现明显逆转（网易引述，8月5日）。交易热度从主流币流向山寨，ETH的成交占比反而缩小，这可以解释为什么BTC站上6.4万美元时ETH涨幅有限。另一组数据同样指向流动性收缩：Cryptopotato 8月5日称加密市场日成交量触及2026年低点。低流动性环境下，清算磁区的触发更依赖单笔大单，插针和急涨急跌的风险都被放大。

山寨端的证据也在增加。DigitalToday报道称，过去24小时Binance上ADA期货成交额超过3.25亿美元、居各平台之首，ADA正在放量冲击100日均线。这类资金流动与Darkfost的占比数据相互印证：主流币的成交份额确实在被分流，ETH正处在这股再分配压力的中心。

资金信号：1亿USDT转入币安

Coinglass在8月5日12:50监测到1亿USDT从未知钱包转入Binance，过去24小时Binance净流入2.29亿USDT（ChainCatcher引述）。稳定币转入交易所通常被当作潜在买盘信号，但转账本身不构成买入，资金也可能用于交易、对冲或后续提现，需要结合成交数据验证。单笔大额转入能说明的是资金在聚集，不能说明方向。

币安8月4日还推出Lite Loan（无清算轻松贷款）：符合条件的主账户用户可抵押BTC借出USDT，单笔上限1,000 USDT、期限固定30天（AiCoin报道）。产品规模小，更多是平台工具层面的信号，反映低波动行情里平台在引导借贷与交易需求，对ETH价格影响有限。

宏观背景：和谈预期与就业数据

风险资产情绪回暖与地缘因素有关。8月5日多家外媒报道，美国与伊朗达成和平协议的可能性上升，美股与风险资产随之反弹（Midas汇总）；市场同时等待美国就业数据，方向尚未落地。ETH与BTC保持高联动，宏观事件对ETH的影响方向和幅度没有一致结论，本文只记录事件本身。

风险提示与数据口径

几点需要单独说明。第一，清算强度是Coinglass按当前持仓计算的快照值，随仓位变化移动，不等于必然触发。第二，稳定币转入交易所不等于买入。第三，本文所有价格、ETF流向、质押数据均为8月5日不同时段的快照，各来源统计口径和时间不同，数值存在小幅差异；实时行情以交易所数据为准。本文涉及行情与观点，均不构成投资建议。

小结

ETH现在夹在1,787与1,957两个清算磁区之间，上下各约85美元。现货ETF在流入，质押率在上升，交易热度却流向山寨，成交占比萎缩，流动性处于年内低位。向下的风险是7.78亿美元多单清算区被触发，向上的机会是放量站上1,957后6.82亿美元空单清算助推反弹。你关注1,787还是1,957？

#baby $BABY  On-chain data sometimes manufactures a kind of fake prosperity. When you see big players almost getting liquidated, they rush in margin overnight. On the surface, the total assets under management (TBV) surges wildly, and it looks lively. But this money never actually created new yield—it's purely to save themselves. When we reviewed Babylon, we must not be fooled by this kind of inflated recharge data. @babylonlabs_io 

This illusion comes from Babylon's underlying mechanics. The first time a player opens a Vault, the protocol assigns a dedicated Position Proxy. After that, no matter how much BTC you deposit again, the system will aggregate it under that same old Proxy, and bundle it together with the previously existing liabilities into one pot. As the collateral thickens, the health factor naturally gets pulled up. So, just looking at new Vaults appearing in old accounts isn't very meaningful. The key thing to watch is this: after new assets are deposited, do they continue to expand the borrowing size?

Once you sort this out, deposit intent splits into two camps. One is the true “offensive” type: the positions were already relatively safe, so adding BTC is to extract liquidity and then lever up—this is real credit expansion. The other is the “hold-to-the-death” type: seeing the health factor getting close to its floor, they rush to deposit to prevent liquidation. These people not only don't dare to borrow more; they even quietly withdraw and repay. At that point, TVL may look great, but in reality, the market’s risk-off sentiment inside the system is already maxed out. If you mix these two up, you'll absolutely misjudge the project's fundamentals.

So when I look at TBV data, I always add an extra filter—calculate what portion of all the newly added BTC in old accounts is absorbed by Proxies sitting on the edge of danger.

Cross-check with total liabilities: if this proportion spikes but borrowing shows no improvement, it means the apparent growth is just covering up bad debt. In the future, a stampede is highly likely. Only if the proportion falls while liabilities rise sharply can it indicate that the funds genuinely want to use this lending engine. To put it plainly: when old clients come back to add margin, it doesn't mean the protocol is more valuable. The same logic applies to the valuation of $BABY : only BTC that continuously generates interest and protocol revenue deserves a premium. BTC used only as ammunition to prevent liquidations is, at best, a reserve buffer. #eth $ETH

content:
#baby $BABY 链上数据有时会制造一种虚假的繁荣。当你看到大户快被强平时连夜打入保证金，表面上总资产规模（TBV）在猛涨，看着挺热闹。但这笔钱根本没去创造新收益，纯粹是为了保命。我们在复盘 Babylon 时，千万别被这种虚高的充值数据给忽悠了。@babylonlabs_io 

这种错觉源自 Babylon 的底层机制。玩家第一次开立 Vault 时，协议会分配一个专属的 Position Proxy。此后无论再充多少 BTC 进去，都会被系统归集到这个老 Proxy 下，跟先前的负债算作一摊。抵押物变厚，健康分自然就被拽上去了。所以，单看老账户里长出新 Vault 是没多大参考意义的，核心得盯住：新资产打进去后，他们有没有继续放大借出规模？

理清这点，入金的真实意图就分化成了两派。一派是真正的“进攻型”：仓位本就很安全，加仓 BTC 是为了套出流动性去加杠杆，这叫真实的信用扩张。另一派则是“死扛型”：眼看健康分快触底，赶紧充值防爆仓。这帮人不仅不敢多借一分钱，甚至还在偷偷撤退还款。这时候 TVL 看着漂亮，实际上盘子里的避险情绪已经拉满。要是把这两者混为一谈，对项目基本面的判断绝对会出错。

所以，我看 TBV 数据时一定会加上一层过滤网——算一算那些处于危险边缘的 Proxy 所吸收的新 BTC，在所有老账户新增资产里究竟占了多大比重。

title: 市场为什么会重新定价一个项目？
subTitle:
前几篇分别讨论了：
反馈循环如何推动持续增长。
网络效应如何放大系统价值。
协同机制如何组织不同参与者。
流动性如何把市场判断转化为真实行动。
这些因素最终会共同指向一个市场最关心的问题：
一个项目为什么会被重新定价？
很多人会把重新定价理解为：
出现了一条重大消息。
宣布了一项合作。
上线了一个新产品。
交易量突然增长。
代币价格开始上涨。
但这些更多是市场可以观察到的现象。
真正的重新定价，发生在更深的一层：
市场对项目未来可能性的判断发生了改变。
⸻
1. 市场定价的不是现在，而是未来的概率
市场不会只根据项目今天拥有什么来定价。
它还在判断：
未来会有多少用户？
能否持续创造收入？
能否形成网络效应？
能否扩大自己的能力边界？
能否在竞争中继续存在？
这些问题都没有确定答案。
因此，市场定价的本质，是对不同未来结果赋予概率。
例如，一个项目可能拥有三种未来：
保持现有规模。
进入持续增长。
逐渐失去竞争力。
市场会根据现有信息，判断每一种结果发生的可能性。
当新的证据出现，并且足以改变这些概率时，重新定价才真正开始。
⸻
2. 消息制造波动，证据推动重新定价
一条重大消息可以迅速吸引注意力。
但注意力变化，不等于市场判断已经变化。
合作公告可能带来短期讨论。
产品上线可能带来短期用户。
激励计划可能带来短期交易量。
这些事件只能说明：
某件事发生了。
但市场还需要继续判断：
这件事是否改变了项目的长期能力？
是否产生了新的用户行为？
是否带来了持续收入？
是否强化了网络效应？
是否改变了竞争格局？
只有当事件逐渐形成证据，市场才可能从“关注它”转向“重新理解它”。
因此：
消息是信号。
行为是验证。
持续结果才是证据。
⸻
3. 真正的重新定价，往往意味着旧解释失效
一个项目长期被市场低估，很多时候并不是市场完全看不到它。
而是市场仍在使用旧的认知框架理解它。
市场可能把它理解为：
一个单一产品。
一个短期热点。
一个依赖补贴的生态。
一个缺少价值捕获的协议。
一个只有技术、没有用户的基础设施。
当项目的真实发展超出这套旧解释时，市场就需要建立新的理解框架。
例如，市场可能逐渐发现：
它不再只是一个产品，而是一套基础设施。
它不再依赖补贴，而是形成了真实需求。
它不再只有用户增长，而是形成了反馈循环。
它不再只创造协议价值，而是开始建立明确的价值捕获机制。
重新定价的关键，不是项目讲出了一个新故事。
而是：
旧故事已经无法解释新的事实。
⸻
4. 一次数据增长，通常不足以改变长期预期
市场每天都会看到大量数据：
交易量上升。
活跃地址增加。
TVL 增长。
收入改善。
开发者数量增加。
但单次数据很容易受到活动、补贴、行情和情绪影响。
真正能够改变市场预期的，通常不是一个数据点。
而是一条持续出现的证据链：
机制发生改变
↓
参与者行为改变
↓
核心数据持续改善
↓
反馈循环开始形成
↓
系统能力得到验证
↓
市场更新长期判断
市场需要看到：
数据为什么增长。
增长是否可以重复。
增长是否依赖外部补贴。
增长能否带来下一轮增长。
如果这些问题逐渐得到回答，市场才可能认为：
这不是短期异常。
而是长期结构发生了变化。
⸻
5. 价格上涨不等于重新定价已经完成
价格变化是市场行为的结果之一。
但不能仅凭价格上涨，就判断项目已经被重新定价。
价格上涨可能来自：
流动性不足。
短期资金集中进入。
市场情绪改善。
杠杆交易推动。
重大消息引发的注意力。
这些因素都可能推动价格，却未必改变长期共识。
真正的重新定价，通常会伴随更广泛的变化：
市场开始用新的语言描述项目。
研究机构开始调整分析框架。
不同类型的参与者开始进入。
开发者、用户和资本形成持续行为。
项目的长期价值来源变得更加清晰。
换句话说：
价格变化可以先于认知变化。
也可以脱离认知变化。
但长期重新定价，最终必须建立在市场理解发生改变之上。
⸻
6. 流动性让重新定价能够发生
即使市场已经形成新的判断，如果缺少流动性，这种判断也很难充分表达。
新的资金可能无法进入。
原有参与者难以调整仓位。
少量交易可能造成过度波动。
价格也难以形成有效发现。
因此，重新定价需要两个条件同时存在：
一是市场对未来的理解发生变化。
二是市场具备把这种变化转化为行动的能力。
这也是为什么流动性不仅影响交易效率，也影响认知进入价格的速度。
可以把这个过程理解为：
新信息
↓
新解释
↓
新预期
↓
资金重新配置
↓
价格重新发现
↓
市场反馈
流动性连接了预期与价格。
⸻
7. 市场重新定价的，不只是价值，也是确定性
很多项目的潜在价值并不低。
但市场仍然可能给予较低估值。
原因是：
价值存在，不等于价值能够实现。
市场还会考虑：
执行风险。
技术风险。
监管风险。
治理风险。
竞争风险。
价值捕获的不确定性。
因此，一个项目即使没有创造出完全新的价值，也可能因为降低了不确定性而被重新定价。
产品持续交付。
机制稳定运行。
收入逐渐验证。
治理冲突得到解决。
价值捕获路径更加明确。
这些变化都会让市场认为：
未来结果变得更加可预测。
所以，重新定价的另一种形式是：
市场没有提高对想象空间的判断，而是降低了对失败概率的判断。
⸻
8. 对 Web3 项目方的启发
很多项目希望市场重新认识自己。
于是首先想到的是：
更换叙事。
扩大传播。
集中发布利好。
寻找更多 KOL。
这些动作可以提高注意力。
但真正推动重新定价的，不是重复告诉市场“我们很有价值”。
而是持续提供能够改变市场判断的新证据。
项目更应该回答：
市场目前如何理解我们？
这种理解中最大的误差是什么？
未来三个月，市场可以验证什么？
未来一年，哪些行为和数据能够证明系统能力？
项目创造的价值，如何进入用户、生态与代币的价值关系？
当这些问题逐渐清晰，传播才会真正发挥作用。
因为传播不是替代证据。
而是帮助市场更准确地理解证据。
⸻
9. 重新定价是一个过程，而不是一个时点
市场很少在某一天突然完成全部认知更新。
更多时候，它经历的是一个渐进过程：
最初，少数人发现变化。
随后，更多人开始讨论。
新的行为和数据不断出现。
旧有质疑逐渐被验证或反驳。
资金开始重新配置。
新的市场共识逐步形成。
因此，重新定价并不只是一次价格跳跃。
而是：
市场认知、参与行为和资本配置逐步对齐的过程。
这也是为什么真正持续的重新定价，往往比一次行情启动更慢。
但一旦形成，也更难被短期情绪完全逆转。
⸻
我的理解是：
信息制造信号。
解释改变认知。
行为提供验证。
证据更新预期。
流动性承载行动。
行动推动重新定价。
所以，市场真正重新定价的，不是一条消息，也不是一个瞬间。
而是当越来越多的证据表明：
这个项目未来能够创造的价值，或者实现这些价值的概率，已经不同于过去。
价格只是重新定价的结果。
市场对未来的理解发生变化，才是重新定价真正的起点。

不是投资建议，仅作为市场机制与行业观察。

今晚不急着押方向。但盘面走成这样，我更愿意站在空头这边等。拒绝在64000附近接多，也拒绝把卖盘枯竭当成反转信号。

---

**【今日主判断】**

偏空。主力很可能借美股情绪做最后一次诱多，把价格推到64800-65400区域耗尽买盘，然后继续南下。
如果BTC日线收盘站上65400，我认错，剧本作废，转为看震荡筑底。

---

**【三条主线】**

**BTC：全场方向锚**
现价64033。上方压力64800/65400，下方支撑62800/61300。
今天盘面最需要警惕的不是价格，是结构：24小时强平1.53亿里，空单占了9739万，多单只有5517万。说明前一波洗掉的是追空的人，不是追多的。现在弹回64k，空头被洗掉了，但现货和ETF并没有明显流入，买盘是虚的。
我的计划很明确：理想的出手区在64800-65400，到这里找小级别反转结构做空，止损放65500上方。如果市场不给反弹，直接跌破62800，我会在62700下方追空，止损63200。

**ETH：弱跟随，不做独立多头**
现价1867。上面有1930的挂空单，下面有1828的市价多单，现在刚好夹在中间。
ETH/BTC汇率被一些人解读为宏观底部已现，但这句话喊了两个月没兑现。EIP-8361和质押相关的讨论短期内也推不动价格。
我的处理是：如果BTC去64800-65400，ETH大概率到1920-1930，那里是我跟着主剧本做空的位置，止损1960上方。如果ETH率先跌破1820，说明山寨比大饼更弱，我会直接加空ETH，目标看1740。
4小时收盘站上1930，我才暂停空ETH。

**SOL：山寨温度计，不是抄底位**
现价73.8。跌穿74之后回到了前期真空区，链上土狗和meme热度也在消退。
SOL这里不单独做空，因为没有好的盈亏比位置。但它的走弱本身就是一个信号：连SOL都带不动链上情绪的时候，其他山寨只会更惨。
如果BTC去测试61300，SOL大概率直接砸穿70。我只把SOL当作风向标，反弹到76.5-77时用来判断山寨是否过热，不考虑直接碰SOL合约。
日线站稳80，我才停止看弱。

---

**【资金暗线】**

**1. AI基金爆雷后的真空**
那个因为高杠杆被强平的AI基金，规模从高点雪崩至百亿级别。卖盘接近枯竭的消息并没有带来买盘回归，市场反而更冷淡。这类事件最大的后劲不是下跌本身，而是把AI叙事的信心抽干了。任何蹭AI的山寨现在都是抽血，不是机会。

**2. 机构暗池占比创纪录**
机构OTC现货占比升到72%，这个数据要分开看。暗池吸筹不等于拉盘，它只是换手的方式变了。如果接下来这个占比开始下滑，反而要警惕，说明暗池接货的阶段可能接近尾声。

---

**【今天不追】**

AMD反弹不碰，止损盘刚被扫过，接飞刀风险太大。AI概念币也不碰，叙事陷阱还在发酵。已经大幅拉升过的标的，今天都不适合追。

---

**【明日盯盘】**

BTC日线是否收在62800下方，跌破则南下加速。
BTC是否有4小时K线收上64800，若出现，空头逻辑弱化，准备减仓。
ETH 4小时是否收在1820以下，破位则1740进入射程。
SOL是否跌破70，确认山寨情绪进一步转冷。

---

**【你怎么选】**
今天你更偏向：
A. 等反弹
B. 等破位
C. 继续观望

---

以上为公开信息整理，不构成投资建议。

#baby $BABY Last month, simply because the official account was hacked, SolvBTC.BBN—which prides itself on a 1:1 peg anchored to a big BTC-backed bet—directly sold into the secondary market at a 7% negative premium. One tweet was enough to cause such a huge hole in liquidity-backed assets that the peg broke. It’s hard not to break out in a cold sweat: what if Babylon’s underlying base layer network really collapses?@babylonlabs_io 

There’s no denying that the “pie” Babylon draws in its whitepaper is enticing—claiming to “designed to extend Bitcoin‘s security to other networks via a shared-security architecture.” For third-party projects like LBTC and SolvBTC.BBN, the playbook is basically the same: lock retail users’ BTC into Babylon’s staking scripts, then bridge it over to Ethereum to trade derivatives.

But the ideal is plump, while the code is bone-dry. Babylon’s infrastructure comes with serious vulnerabilities. Previously, OpenZeppelin already pinpointed a critical flaw in how it handles delegated state. Zellic’s audit report was even more blunt, issuing a red alert with seven Criticals (extremely critical) and three High-severity issues. If you go to GitHub and look through the security advisories, the scene is nothing short of a disaster:

GHSA-869w-47c6-fq8q: With a single routine IBC cross-chain action, the entire chain can freeze.

GHSA-m6wq-66p2-c8pc: Just toss in the hash of an empty block maliciously, and you can take the nodes down.

GHSA-4rmq-mc2c-r495: The boldest kind of “ghost staking”—the principal has already been withdrawn, yet the system keeps chugging along and paying out rewards.

No wonder, in the eyes of security institutions, Babylon’s risk score shot up to 57/100—pulling the industry-wide average of 42/100 up by a full 15 points.

With the foundation layers shaking wildly, the DeFi “daisy-chain” on top is even more fraught with danger. Previously, Solv Protocol’s BTC+ suffered badly: once the private key leaked, hackers could immediately bypass authorization and upgrade proxy contracts to print fake bills at scale. Now look at the currently popular LBTC—its TVL has been inflated to $1.5 billion, with funds deeply interwoven and spread across 15 chains. Imagine this: if Babylon—the base layer—goes down, the so-called rock-solid 1:1 redemption ratio would instantly become a joke.

Everyone needs to do the math: when the risks from the underlying chain and the pitfalls in the outer contracts stack together, the probability of funds reaching zero multiplies. A protocol with a risk score far beyond the 15-point margin above the average alert line, covered in a bunch of fatal bugs—paired with derivatives that have also hit serious security issues—#eth $ETH

#baby  Yesterday, while running the Babylon testnet TBV to redeem BTC, I was shocked by the pop-up: “usage fee: 0.0001 BTC”. I originally thought it would be proportional fees, but it turned out to be an absolute value deduction. @babylonlabs_io 

Quick back-of-the-envelope math: at today’s BTC average price of more than $60k, if you deposit 1 BTC to borrow $40k, the per-round “friction” quickly exceeds $6 each time you go in and out. If someone is used to trading in and out (band trading) and does it ten-odd times a month, the cost of several tens of dollars is simply gone—translated annually, it can consume close to 1% of the principal. The official logic behind this fixed-fee model is actually very straightforward: it’s essentially a disguised way to raise the transaction threshold, wash out retail users and high-frequency capital, and only leave whales and institutions to do long-term trades.

Let’s break down the deflationary blueprint the team drew up under $BABY . Their idea is: take the BTC profit earned, dump it onto the chain for an automated auction, then burn it after swapping it for $BABY . This setup looks hardcore, but the weak spot is—who will take the other side? Compared with Aave, a long-standing leader, which simply cuts out the profit from lending interest and distributes it directly to AAVE stakers—the on-chain link is short. With TBV, they insist on adding an extra auction layer. That means if the token price is sluggish and there’s a lack of real external buy orders (right now there basically aren’t other use cases besides voting and staking), this deflation engine faces the risk of stalling.

In the current supply-demand imbalance, the people actually competing for auctions are very likely not die-hard token holders, but rather a professional arbitrage army watching the spread. As long as the pool offers enough profit room, the bots will move like crazy. In effect, the protocol is bleeding to subsidize—passively handing over profits that should belong to the ecosystem to yield farmers.

At the end of the day, the core of this fee-rate scheme is still to ride on BTC’s insane liquidity, and force feed usage scenarios to their own token. In the current ecosystem’s staking, more than $5 billion worth of BTC has already been locked in. Even if a little leaks into TBV, the absolute value of the fees is not trivial. But whether this big cake can actually be eaten depends on whether fixed-rate products and other fixed-income offerings can truly land on the institutional side. If the underlying lending engine can’t really get running, then all these sophisticated token designs above are ultimately just talk on paper. #eth  $ETH

简单算笔账：按当前 BTC 6万多刀的均价，如果抵押 1 块大饼借出 4万U，一进一出的单次磨损就超 6 美金。假如有老哥习惯做波段，一个月倒腾个十来次，大几十刀的成本直接没了，折算成年化能吃掉接近 1% 的本金。官方这套固定计费的逻辑其实很直白：就是变相提高交易门槛，把散户和高频资金洗出去，只留大户和机构在里面做长线。

再去拆解下团队给 $BABY 画的通缩蓝图。他们的设想是：把赚到的 BTC 利润丢到链上搞自动拍卖，换成 $BABY 后进行销毁。这套路看着很硬核，但软肋在于——谁来接盘？对比一下老牌龙头 Aave，人家直接把借贷利息的利润切出来分给 AAVE 质押者，链路极短。而 TBV 这边非要多加一层拍卖环节，这就导致如果代币价格萎靡、缺乏外部真实买单（目前除了投票和质押基本没别的场景），这套通缩引擎就面临熄火的风险。

在目前这种供需失衡的情况下，真正跑去竞拍的大概率不是持币铁粉，而是盯着差价的职业套利大军。只要池子里给足利润空间，机器人就会疯狂搬砖。这相当于协议在流血补贴，把本该属于生态的利润被动让利给羊毛党。

说到底，这套费率玩法的核心，还是想借势大饼的逆天流动性，硬给自家代币喂使用场景。目前整个生态的 staking 里已经沉淀了超 50亿美金 的 BTC，哪怕稍微渗出一点到 TBV 里，手续费的绝对值都不容小觑。但这块大蛋糕能不能吃进嘴里，还得看 fixed-rate 等固收产品能否真正在机构端落地。要是底层借贷引擎转不起来，上面这些精妙的代币设计终究只是纸上谈兵。#eth  $ETH

translatedData.content:
#baby  I personally went and ran a test on Babylon's testnet. When I was about to withdraw BTC from TBV, the line on the interface—“usage fee: 0.0001 BTC”—really took me by surprise. This bill isn’t cheap when you add it up, because it uses a highly exclusionary absolute-value deduction rather than the industry-standard percentage-based fee.

Let’s rough-estimate: with the current BTC price of over $60,000, even if you provide liquidity by staking 1 BTC-equivalent worth and borrowing 40k USDT (U), the loss per round trip exceeds $6. For those retail users who prefer quick in-and-out trades, if they shuffle it ten times in a month, dozens of dollars of the principal end up getting drained for no good reason. Converted into a fixed annualized rate, it’s like cutting off nearly 1% of the “meat.” This setting goes against common sense—clearly it’s about money laundering, trying to keep scattered high-frequency players out while only letting sleeping giant whales remain for the long haul.@babylonlabs_io 

I dug through the documents and found that the deflationary “BTC” the team designed for $BABY  also hides a catch. Their core idea is to take the captured BTC profits, send them on-chain into an auction, convert them into the native token, and then burn it. The logic is perfect, but the fatal question is—who pays for the deal? Looking back at Aave, the interest spread from borrowing is directly distributed to AAVE stakers, with no funny business. But TBV insists on forcing an auction mechanism. In a market where the token currently lacks killer application scenarios other than serving as votes and staking collateral, if trading sentiment cools, this seemingly flashy deflation engine is very likely to completely stall. In the end, the only ones active in there will probably be a wool-pulling army chasing tiny price differences. Once the pool trades at a discount, the scripts will mindlessly arb—meaning the protocol ends up subsidizing arbitrageurs with its own funds.

Strip away the layers of packaging, and the ultimate purpose of this model is simply to grab onto the BTC’s outrageously liquid flow and forcibly create a “consumption scenario” for $BABY  out of thin air. The ecosystem’s pools already hold over $5 billion in total assets; as long as even a small amount overflows into the lending business, the volume of fees it generates shouldn’t be underestimated. However, for all of this to become reality, the key prerequisite is that the official side must quickly make solid fixed-rate products—bring in the real needs of traditional institutions.#eth $ETH

咱们粗略估算一下：以当前大饼 6万多刀 的盘面价来看，就算你质押 1 个去融 4万U 的流动性，进出单趟的损耗就超过 6 美金。对于那些偏好短平快的散户来说，假设单月倒腾十回，大几十刀的本金就平白无故地消耗殆尽了，折成固定年化相当于割了近 1% 的肉。这种反常识的设定，摆明了就是在做资金清洗，企图把零散的高频玩家挡在门外，只让沉睡的巨鲸长线留存。@babylonlabs_io 

顺藤摸瓜研究了下文档，发现团队给 $BABY 画的通缩大饼同样暗藏玄机。他们的核心设想是将截留的 BTC 利润，丢到链上开启竞价，兑换成原生代币后进行销毁。逻辑很完美，但死穴在于——谁来掏钱买单？回头瞅瞅 Aave，借款产生的息差直接分发给 AAVE 质押大户，没有任何弯弯绕绕。而 TBV 非要硬塞一个拍卖环节，在当前代币除了充当选票和质押凭证、缺乏其他杀手级应用场景的背景下，如果盘面遇冷，这套看似拉风的通缩引擎极易彻底停摆。最终活跃在里面的，恐怕全是盯着微小价差的羊毛大军。一旦池子出现折价，脚本就会无脑搬砖，这等于协议在自掏腰包补贴套利客。

扒开层层外衣，这套模型的终极目的，其实就是想抱紧大饼逆天流动性的大腿，强行为 $BABY 凭空捏造出一个消耗场景。当前整个生态的池子里已经沉淀了超 50亿美金 的天量资产，只要有零星溢出流向借贷业务，其产生的手续费体量都不容小觑。然而，这一切能够成真的大前提，是官方必须尽快把 fixed-rate 这种固收类产品做扎实，把传统机构的真实需求给引进来。#eth $ETH

The medium-term impact is even more concerning. The article mentions the possibility of stricter regulation—this is the real hidden risk. Currently, BTC is consolidating around $64,150, but this level isn’t solid support. It’s likely to face continued pressure in the near term. In plain terms: the main business makes money, the side business loses. An unrealized loss of $540 million on the books is not a small figure.

One sentence to make it clear
SpaceX’s first earnings report after going public beat revenue expectations, but it holds 18,712 BTC, which has been down $540 million on paper over the past six months—ringing alarm bells for institutions that are hoarding coins.

What happened
SpaceX just released its first earnings report after listing. Its core business is indeed strong: revenue beat Wall Street expectations, and losses are narrowing. But what the crypto market is really watching is its BTC holdings—holding 18,712 BTC, and over six months its book value shrank by $540 million. Honestly, the number is eye-catching, showing that even a company on Musk’s scale can’t withstand unrealized loss pressure during BTC’s downcycle. This is completely different from MicroStrategy’s “hold no matter what” logic. SpaceX’s main businesses are aerospace and Starlink; crypto assets are only allocations. An unrealized loss that grows large looks very ugly on the accounting side.

Impact on the market
Short term: the key transmission chain is like this—SpaceX’s $540 million unrealized loss → other listed companies will re-evaluate their coin-hoarding strategy → new capital won’t dare to enter, and existing positions loosen → increased sell pressure on BTC. My view is clear: bearish in the short term—don’t rush to bottom-fish. title: If $BTC Falls to $50K, Could That Actually Be a Bullish Cycle Bottom? 👀
subTitle:
$BTC  is currently trading around $63.5K, while $ETH  is around $1.86K. The biggest question right now is:
Could Bitcoin experience another major correction and eventually revisit the $50K area?
In my view, this scenario shouldn’t be completely dismissed. In fact, if $50K eventually becomes a major cycle low, it may be better understood from a broader market-cycle perspective rather than simply being viewed as a “crash.”
🟠 $BTC: Is $50K Really That Bearish?
Let’s assume Bitcoin is currently around $63.5K and eventually drops toward $50K.
That would represent a decline of roughly 21% from the current level.
A 21% correction would obviously hurt, but historically, a move of this size is not unprecedented for Bitcoin.
The more interesting part is the drawdown from the previous cycle high.
If we use approximately $126K as the previous cycle high, then a $50K Bitcoin would represent roughly a 60% drawdown from that peak.
And that matters.
Because for a full bear-market environment, a $50K bottom would actually be relatively high compared with Bitcoin’s historical drawdowns.
A bear market doesn’t necessarily have to mean an 80–90% collapse every cycle. As Bitcoin matures and the market structure evolves, the magnitude of future drawdowns can also change.
So if $50K eventually becomes the cycle bottom, it could arguably signal a relatively strong market structure rather than a catastrophic collapse.
🔵 But $ETH Could Face More Downside
Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum can behave like a higher-beta asset.
That means if BTC falls 20%, there is no guarantee that ETH will fall by the same percentage.
Suppose BTC moves toward $50K and ETH experiences a 30% or greater correction from its current ~$1.86K area.
That could bring ETH closer to approximately $1,300.
This is not a guaranteed target.
It is simply a scenario-based calculation.
However, if ETH is currently pushing into a resistance area, the risk/reward of opening fresh long positions should be evaluated carefully.
📉 Why ETH Resistance Matters
For me, the most important thing isn’t simply the price target—it’s how price reacts at key levels.
If ETH reaches resistance and repeatedly gets rejected while BTC simultaneously loses important support, the downside scenario could become more convincing.
On the other hand, if ETH breaks resistance with strong volume and confirmation, the bearish thesis could weaken significantly.
So I wouldn’t say:
“ETH is definitely going to $1,300.”
Instead, I would look at it this way:
Resistance rejection → higher probability of bearish continuation
Resistance breakout + confirmation → bearish thesis becomes weaker
That’s a much more realistic way to trade with the market rather than trying to predict every move.
🧠 The Biggest Lesson: Scenario Planning > Price Prediction
One of the biggest mistakes in crypto is treating a single price target as a certainty.
BTC could reach $50K.
It could also reverse around $60K.
ETH could reach $1,300.
Or a strong recovery could begin before it ever gets there.
Nobody knows for sure.
That’s why a smarter approach is to prepare for multiple scenarios instead of going all-in on one prediction.
🟢 Bullish Scenario
BTC holds major support → reclaims resistance → bearish thesis weakens → ETH could also recover.
🟡 Neutral Scenario
BTC remains range-bound → liquidity builds → ETH volatility increases → market waits for confirmation.
🔴 Bearish Scenario
BTC loses major support → correction extends toward the $50K region → ETH underperforms BTC → $1,300 or lower could become a potential demand zone.
💰 What Should Long-Term Investors Consider?
If your long-term thesis is that Bitcoin’s adoption story remains intact, then a correction doesn’t necessarily have to be viewed only as something to fear.
It can also become a potential opportunity for disciplined capital allocation.
But the key here is not trying to perfectly time the bottom—it’s risk management.
Instead of deploying all available capital at once, a staggered buying strategy can be a more disciplined approach.
For example:
BTC: Accumulate gradually across multiple support zones.
ETH: Evaluate strength and confirmation alongside BTC.
Altcoins: Keep position sizes smaller until Bitcoin confirms its direction.
Leverage: Avoid excessive leverage, especially during high volatility.
Because the market can always prove your analysis wrong.
🔥 My Take
To me, the $50K BTC scenario is not necessarily a panic target—it could potentially become an opportunity zone.
If Bitcoin really corrects from around $126K to $50K and establishes a major cycle bottom there, that would represent roughly a 60% drawdown while still showing relatively strong performance compared with some historical bear markets.
And if BTC moves toward $50K, it wouldn’t be surprising to see ETH experience a deeper percentage decline.
In that scenario, $1,300 ETH could become a potential downside area to monitor—but I would not treat it as a guaranteed bottom or exact prediction.
Ultimately, the most important signal will be:
Is BTC holding support, or is it breaking down and creating new lower lows?
Personally, I’d rather focus on levels, confirmation, and risk/reward than chase a single price target.
Because in crypto, the biggest opportunities are sometimes not created when everyone is bullish—
but when fear is high and quality assets become available at significant discounts. 🧠📉

The team talks at length about no-bridging, self-custody, and the native big vision, wrapping the underlying architecture in a highly geeky, tech-obsessed style. But do mainstream players care about how the underlying cryptography works? What people really care about is simply this: after I press the button, what stage is my asset at right now? They’re busy showing off technical skills while ignoring the most basic front-end feedback—this is a typical ailment of infrastructure projects in the current circle.

And as for the so-called prosperity of the testnet: the official claims that after the May end rollout, they’ve successfully deployed over 2,000 pools (Vaults). Sounds impressive, but on closer inspection, the core active participants are actually only a little over seventy people.

In an environment with airdrop expectations, it’s standard practice for studios or solo users to open multiple instances and interact like crazy. Hiding limitations by citing absolute totals doesn’t prove the maturity of the interaction flow. The truly hard-core and disclosure-worthy data must be: the final conversion rate of fully built pools, the average time confirmed on-chain, node error frequency and the dropout ratio, and the correct intervention guide after the system freezes or crashes.

Right now, the loudest outcry in the community is precisely about the “initial positioning/building the first position,” the part with the lowest threshold. The big-promise mainnet blocks being slow is an objective fact. But if the interface doesn’t even provide precise status anchors, then players are left facing a pure black box. Should they keep grinding, refresh the webpage, or re-authorize? It all comes down to gut feeling. The official leaked that the new UI will fix these blind spots, but until it’s formally opened to the public, it only counts as internal self-amusement.

If the opening move already makes retail users break into a cold sweat, then wouldn’t the subsequent, more complicated steps—collateralized borrowing, settlement, and clearing—be an absolute disaster scenario? No matter how elegantly designed the underlying framework is, it still has to keep those obscure mechanisms hidden under the hood. A truly polished on-chain application isn’t one where the ideal path just works—it’s one where even if something goes wrong, a non-technical novice can follow the pop-up guidance and get unstuck easily. #eth $ETH

#baby $BABY  While reviewing the TBV withdrawal mechanism of @babylonlabs_io , most of the market discussion is about ZK—but what I’m actually focused on is an otherwise insignificant detail: WOTS key pairs.

When we set up a Vault in the protocol, the system dispatches a set of claimer artifacts, including pre-signed transactions and challenge data. In normal circumstances, with a Vault Provider on hand, withdrawal operations face no obstacles. But what if a node goes silent or you run into an unavoidable network outage? Then users have to pull out these files themselves, personally deploy the command-line workflow to trigger the Claim, Assert, and Payout steps, and manually redeem the BTC back. That’s precisely the essence of “decentralization”: the platform may go down, but you must have the confidence to exit on your own.

However, rights and obligations are equal. By absolutely holding the power of life and death over your assets, you also take on custodial burdens of the same magnitude.

Imagine an extremely realistic scenario: one day, the Provider really stops responding, and you happened to switch to another device—yet that critical WOTS credential was never saved at all. What then? Although the official architecture has a Security Council as an early backstop mechanism, that’s not the same kind of operation as clicking the “Withdraw” button on a typical front-end webpage. A proof at the cryptographic layer that “it can be recovered” doesn’t mean ordinary players in the market have the hands-on ability to execute it at any time.

That’s why judging TBV’s true experience purely by the total deposits on the front end is self-deception. I think the following three pieces of data are far more revealing:

Backup completion rate: How many people actually and obediently saved that self-rescue material?

Passive redemption rate: What proportion of events actually involve self-claim?

Time required for real self-rescue: For a non-technical person, how much effort is needed to complete the full workflow?

If you can’t get past this hurdle, then there will always be a tragic barrier between “able to withdraw anytime” and “able to withdraw easily.” For #baby , the more solid the core role of the Vault, the more explosive the value of $BABY  in enabling infrastructure and subsequent governance. But whether the system can handle a massive influx of funds depends on its resilience in the worst sudden scenarios.

#baby $BABY 翻阅 @babylonlabs_io 的 TBV 提现机制时，市场基本都在讨论 ZK，但我盯上的却是一个极不起眼的细节——WOTS 密钥对。

当我们在协议中建立 Vault 时，系统会派发一份囊括预签名交易和挑战数据的 claimer artifacts 资料。正常光景下，有 Vault Provider 伺候着，提现操作毫无阻力。可万一节点装死或者遭遇不可抗力断网了呢？这时候用户就得掏出这套文件，亲自部署命令行去触发 Claim、Assert 和 Payout 流程，手动把 BTC 赎回来。这恰恰是“去中心化”的精髓：平台可以停摆，但你必须有单干退出的底气。

可是，权利与义务是对等的。把资产的生杀大权绝对捏在自己手里，意味着你要承担同量级的保管重担。

试想一个极度现实的处境：某天 Provider 真的停止响应了，而你偏偏又换了一台设备，那个要命的 WOTS 凭证压根没做任何保存。该如何收场？虽说官方架构了 Security Council 作为早期兜底机制，但这跟平时在前端网页上敲击“Withdraw”按钮完全不在一个操作维度。底层密码学层面证明了“能挽回”，并不等同于市场上的普通玩家具备随时实操的能力。

正因如此，评判 TBV 的真实体验，光盯着前端的存入总量完全是自欺欺人。我反倒认为以下三个数据更为致命：

备份完成率： 到底有多少人老老实实存好了那份自救资料？

被动赎回率： 实际发生 self-claim 的事件比例究竟占多大？

真实自救耗时： 一个非技术出身的人跑通全流程需要耗费多少精力？

跨不过这道坎，“随时能退”与“轻松能退”之间就永远隔着一层可悲的壁障。对于 #baby 而言，Vault 的核心枢纽作用越扎实，$BABY 赋能基建和后续治理的价值才越有爆发力。但系统能不能接得住庞大的增量资金，取决于其应对最差突发状况的韧性。

title: ETH跌破1900ETF却在疯狂吸筹谁在慌谁在抄底
subTitle:
## ETH跌破1900，ETF却在疯狂吸筹：谁在慌，谁在抄底？

8月5日， $ETH 交出了主流币中最差的成绩单。

价格1866美元，24小时跌2.3%，周跌2.6%——是主流币里唯一周度负收益的品种。与此同时，BTC周涨1%，BNB周涨5%，SOL基本持平。

ETH沦为"最弱主流币"，但奇怪的是：机构资金不仅没跑，反而在加速进场。

### ETF资金用脚投票：BTC在跑，ETH在吸

8月1日那天，BTC现货ETF净流出2.654亿美元，贝莱德IBIT单日就跑了1.227亿。但同一天，ETH现货ETF净流入900万美元，其中贝莱德ETHB贡献了1538万美元。

这已经是ETH ETF连续第二天净流入了。

拉长看更明显——7月ETH ETF连续第四周正流入，月度累计3.652亿美元。而BTC ETF在7月虽然月度净流入1.724亿美元，但7月31日单日就砸出了2.654亿的流出。

#ETH #以太坊 #加密货币

### 巨鲸在做什么？

链上数据更分裂。

地址0x2684今天又买了7919枚ETH（约1489万美元），从6月30日至今累计吃进74265枚ETH，均价1771美元，浮盈超900万。

一个疑似BitMine的钱包通过FalconX买入了10460枚ETH（约1948万美元）。两个新地址在10小时内合计囤了18914枚ETH（约3520万美元）。

但也有人在割肉——Arthur Hayes上周卖了2364枚ETH，亏损24.1万美元。

一边是巨鲸疯狂扫货，一边是散户恐慌出逃。这种分裂在历史上往往是阶段性底部的特征——但注意，"往往"不等于"一定"。

### 为什么ETH这么弱？

三个原因：

**第一，利率压力。** 30年期美债收益率突破5.2%，创2006年以来新高。不产生现金流的资产（包括ETH）在无风险利率5%以上的环境里，吸引力天然下降。CME数据显示9月加息概率已升至82%。

**第二，BTC资金虹吸。** BTC市占率升至58.5%，资金在避险情绪下向龙头集中。ETH/BTC汇率持续走弱，说明市场不是不看 crypto，而是只看BTC。

**第三，叙事真空。** 上半年ETH的Layer2故事讲得差不多了，新叙事还没跟上。EIP-8361提案虽然有话题性，但距离落地还早。相比之下，BTC有ETF叙事撑着，BNB有CZ回归和Giggle Academy的热度。

### 但有一个数据值得注意

质押队列。

截至7月底，约250万枚ETH在等待激活质押，排队时间43天，而退出队列几乎为零。这意味着大量ETH将被锁定，流通中的抛压正在缩减。

供给在缩，需求在增（ETF+巨鲸），但价格还在跌——这种局面不会持续太久。要么价格追上基本面，要么基本面被证伪。

### 关键价位

ETH上方阻力1876-1880美元（4小时EMA突破位），第二阻力1892-1895美元。如果收复1880，有望向1930-2000反弹。

下方支撑1859-1860美元（EMA144短期生命线），跌破则看1844美元，再破就直奔1810甚至1700了。RSI接近超卖区但尚未止跌，短线仍偏空。

### 一句话总结

ETH现在最尴尬——它既没有BTC的"数字黄金"避险属性，也没有SOL的"高性能新链"成长预期，卡在中间不上不下。但ETF持续流入和巨鲸扫货说明，聪明钱在押注这个"尴尬"是暂时的。

你觉得ETH会先破1800还是先回到2000？评论区说说你的看法。

title: 散户最喜欢抄底的地方，为什么往往是主力最喜欢出货的地方？
subTitle:
市场里最危险的，很多时候不是顶部，而是一个“看起来特别像底部”的地方。

价格跌了很多，群里开始刷“不能再跌了”；一根长下影线出来，大家立刻喊“主力护盘”；再来一波反弹，抄底的人开始集体庆祝：看吧，我就说这里是底。

然后，价格再次掉头。

这时候散户才发现，自己抄的可能不是底，而是大资金临时搭出来的接盘区。

为什么大资金喜欢在这种位置卖？

因为这里的流动性最厚。

前面被套的人想解套，后面空仓的人想抄底，合约玩家还喜欢开多。大家的买入理由五花八门，但最终都在同一个位置挂出了买单。

对大资金来说，这就像前线突然出现了一条补给线。有人愿意接货，它才有条件把仓位慢慢转出去。

近期$BTC 就在6.2万至6.4万美元附近反复震荡，很多人把6.2万美元当成“铁底”。但strategy最新账本显示，公司曾以平均63,957美元卖出1,638枚BTC，同时仍持有842,138枚BTC。这个动作不代表市场一定要跌，也不代表Strategy在故意割韭菜，但它至少告诉我们：反弹区间同样可能是机构调度仓位、释放供应的地方。

再看一个典型的小币案例。

某个山寨币从1美元跌到0.5美元，0.5美元刚好是前期低点。散户一看，便宜了一半，立刻开始“价值投资”；随后价格快速反弹到0.58美元，成交量看起来也不错，合约持仓量却同步增加，资金费率重新转正。

很多人以为这是反转，实际上可能只是新的多头杠杆进场。

一旦价格再次跌破0.5美元，前面抄底的人止损，合约多头被强平，卖压继续踩踏。你以为自己买在地板，结果地板下面还有地下室。

所以，抄底不能只看价格便不便宜，而要看结构有没有改变。

价格有没有停止创新低？反弹能不能突破前一个低点？上涨时有没有现货成交量配合？未平仓合约是不是在价格上涨时疯狂增加？资金费率是不是已经重新变得拥挤？

尤其要记住：下跌加OI上升，不一定是主力做空，也可能是抄底多头正在接飞刀；多头大量清算，也不代表马上就是底部，可能只是第一轮清洗刚刚开始。

真正稳妥的做法，不是看到下跌就满仓冲进去，而是先保留粮草，等市场证明它真的站住了，再分批部署。仓位要小，失效位置要提前想好，不能因为“已经跌了很多”就不断补仓。
抄底不是比谁胆子大，更不是为了证明自己比市场聪明。

真正的底部，往往不是跌得最狠的那根K线，而是卖压被消耗之后，价格开始用时间换空间，市场重新建立起攻守秩序。

别急着接刀。

先确认，刀是不是已经落地。

 #BTC  #ETH  #抄底  #交易心理  #资金流向

translatedData.title: The place where retail investors love to buy the dip—why is it often the place where the main force most likes to unload inventory?
translatedData.subTitle:
The most dangerous place in the market is often not the top, but a spot that looks exactly like a bottom.

After the price drops a lot, the group starts spamming “it can’t drop any further”; then a long lower shadow appears, and everyone immediately yells “the main force is defending the price.” After another wave of rebound, the bargain hunters begin celebrating together: “See? I told you this is the bottom.”

Then, the price turns direction again downward.

Only then do retail investors realize that what they bought into might not be the bottom—it's a temporary handoff zone set up by the big funds.

Why do large funds like to sell from this kind of position?

Because the liquidity here is the thickest.

Crypto Daily｜August 5: An Ethereum no-new-mint proposal shakes DeFi

Bitcoin stabilizes around 64,000, with a daily gain of about 1 percentage point; ETH is mostly flat near 1,870. Today’s biggest topic in the圈 (industry circle) is a new Ethereum proposal: EIP-8361, jointly proposed by six core researchers (including Justin Drake). The central logic is that, as the amount of staking increases, validators will gradually have their incremental issuance rewards burned. When the staked amount reaches half of the total supply, new coin issuance would drop to zero. At present, 41 million ETH are already staked, and another 2.5 million are queued to enter. At this pace, without intervention, it could break 70 million within two years. If the proposal passes, Ethereum’s scarcity narrative would be fully amplified—but Aave has already jumped in to oppose it, saying that zeroing staking rewards would collapse the lending flywheel. ether.fi’s founder also said it would push out retail validators, turning staking into a game for large institutions. A rushed submission after just a two-day period for soliciting feedback—so the controversy is definitely substantial.

There are also on-chain moves. On August 3, a large transfer of 16,400 BTC worth over $1 billion was made, but it didn’t go to an exchange—more like an internal transfer between custody wallets rather than a sell signal. Another old dormant address, inactive for seven years, also moved 2,931 BTC, with a cost basis of only $6,500; now at 64K it’s nearly ten times higher. In the altcoin space, ZEC rose 11 percentage points in a week due to the Ironwood upgrade. The new mechanism is mathematically verifiable for circulating supply and resolves the most criticized issue of “invisible inflation” in privacy coins—so the narrative really hit some large players’ pain points. LINK hasn’t moved much in price, but BitGo has just migrated $7.4 billion worth of WBTC to CCIP, and with cooperation involving Swift and UBS progressing, the institutional infrastructure track has been quietly laid out all along.

At this stage, Bitcoin can be quite grindy, and the altcoin rotation rhythm is fast. Rather than constantly switching positions, it’s better to hold onto the few lines you understand. Cultivation, as they say, is about who can stay seated.

大饼在64000一线稳住，日涨幅约1个点，ETH在1870附近横盘。今天圈内最大的话题是以太坊的一个新提案——六位核心研究者（包括Justin Drake）联合提出的EIP-8361，核心逻辑是随着质押量上升逐步烧掉验证者的增发奖励，质押量达到总供应一半时新币增发直接归零。目前已经有4100万枚ETH在质押，排队等着进场的还有250万枚，按这速度不干预的话两年内破7000万。这提案要是过了，ETH的稀缺性逻辑直接拉满，但Aave那边已经跳出来反对，说质押收益归零会搞崩借贷飞轮，ether.fi创始人也说这会挤走散户验证者、让质押变成大机构的游戏。两天征求意见期就匆匆提交，争议属实不小。

链上也有动作。8月3号一笔16400枚BTC的大额转账价值超10亿美元，但没进交易所，更像是托管钱包的内部迁移而非抛售信号。另一个沉睡了七年的老地址也动了2931枚BTC，成本才6500刀，现在64K已经翻了快十倍。山寨这边ZEC因为Ironwood升级一周涨了11个点——新机制可以数学验证流通量，把隐私币最被诟病的"隐形增发"问题给解了，叙事确实戳中了一些大资金的痛点。LINK虽然价格没怎么动，但BitGo刚把74亿美金的WBTC迁移到了CCIP上，加上Swift和瑞银的合作推进，机构的基建线其实一直在铺。

这个阶段大饼走得比较磨人，山寨轮动节奏也快，与其频繁换仓不如守住自己看懂的几条线。修行嘛，比的是谁能坐得住。

#baby $BABY @babylonlabs_io  Many players think that the collapse of on-chain protocols is often caused by endless dumping of token prices. In reality, the truly fatal blow might simply be a transaction sequence number that cannot be packaged (Nonce). I’ve actually stepped on this mine in real practice.

At the time, my contract order had already hit the liquidation-redline threshold. I immediately shifted funds from the mainnet to top up the position. Strangely, even though the wallet popped up a confirmation prompt and the funds were absolutely sufficient, the transaction just stalled in place. After tracing and investigating step by step, I finally found the culprit: the previous routine interaction had been stuck on-chain, blocking the pipeline. As a result, the sequence numbers for the subsequent transfers could only be pushed forward, wasting and exhausting time and throughput. In the end, I had to bleed heavily and use a maxed-out fee to forcibly override the earlier pending transaction, barely avoiding disaster.

This episode made me extremely concerned about the underlying logic of Babylon (@BabylonLabs_io). Their officially operated Liquidator Bot was actually attached to a fixed wallet, sending commands one by one based on sequence numbers. The program is set to detect dangerous positions every 10 seconds; once it identifies one, it targets and breaks them down sequentially.

The hard flaw of this model is that once it encounters a cascading market move (a waterfall行情), as long as the very first order in line gets blocked by the network, the entire long chain of subsequent liquidation actions turns into a “road to nowhere.”

The core game here is essentially a tug-of-war between two forces: the speed at which the system generates losses from positions running into liquidation, versus the network’s real execution efficiency in closing positions.

When the momentum of losses spreading far exceeds the efficiency of liquidations, the congestion queue grows infinitely longer. At first, the collateral still has some buffer. But by the end, it’s often not even enough to cover the small remainder needed to repay the borrowed amount. This also reveals the brutal truth of the on-chain world: the “permission to allow disposal” granted by smart contracts exists only at the theoretical level. When it comes to the real test, what truly pulls the ecosystem back from the brink of death is hard power—node quality, Gas fee competition, the depth of reserves, and the ability to cut in line and sprint ahead.

Total locked assets are just a filter from prosperous times. The true lifeline for surviving extreme one-sided selloffs is high-concurrency processing capability.

My inviolable trading rule has always been: harvest cycle dividends, and guard against micro-level hidden arrows. For any safety blind spots, I will maintain zero tolerance. Next, I will continue digging into the operational blind spots of $BABY . #eth $ETH

当时我的合约单子已经触及爆仓红线，我立刻从主网调配补仓头寸。诡异的是，明明钱包弹出了确认提示，资金也绝对充足，但这笔款项就是原地踏步。顺藤摸瓜排查后才发现，罪魁祸首是前一笔日常交互被死死堵在链上，导致后续转账的序列号只能顺延干耗。最后我不得不痛下血本，用拉满的手续费强行覆盖掉前置交易，才惊险躲过一劫。

这起插曲让我对 Babylon（@BabylonLabs_io）的底层逻辑产生了极大担忧。他们官方运作的 Liquidator Bot，居然是挂在一个固定钱包下，按照序列号挨个发送指令的。程序设定每隔10秒侦测一次危险仓位，一旦锁定便逐个击破。

这种模式的硬伤在于：一旦遭遇瀑布行情，只要排在最前头的那一单被网络堵死，后续一长串的平仓动作就全变成了“断头路”。

这里面的核心博弈，其实是两股力量的拔河：系统生成穿仓亏空的速度，对比网络真实执行平仓的效率。

当亏空蔓延的势头远超平仓效率时，拥堵队列就会无限拉长。起初抵押物还有点盈余空间，熬到最后往往连填补借款的零头都不够。这也揭示了链上世界残酷的真相：智能合约赋予的“准许处置”权限只停留在理论层面，大考之时，真正能把生态从死亡线上拽回来的，全凭节点质量、Gas博弈、备用金深度和插队抢跑的硬实力。

锁仓总资产不过是繁荣时期的滤镜，高并发的处理能力才是扛过极端单边下杀的救命稻草。

我的操盘铁律始终如一：吃周期红利，防微观暗箭。对任何安全死角我都会保持零容忍，接下来，我会继续深挖 $BABY 的运行盲区。#eth $ETH

#baby $BABY @babylonlabs_io  Babylon’s most eye-catching selling point is: “You can earn interest without surrendering the big pie.” But if you look closely, the so-called absolute control is actually filtered. At the base layer, Taproot has the time lock and the rule for punishment via forfeiture directly hardwired into the chain. It’s like you hold the safe’s key, but turning the combination must follow the preset rules. If there’s a sudden plunge and you want to retreat fast, the constraints baked into the code will leave you unable to move. “The key is yours” doesn’t mean you can instantly walk away with everything—there are deeper mechanics behind the door.

As it stands, the contract management group is, in essence, still a centralized entity that requires extreme trust. If the network goes down, a giant whale trying to withdraw large funds will very possibly run into a snag.

Also, the technique of reusing randomness to expose private keys in order to carry out punishment is extremely impressive in the whitepaper. But the real test comes once the Phase 2 network goes live and everyone must sign the predefined transactions—then you’ll see what it’s really made of. How resilient is the node software? Will hackers find loopholes? The unknown variables in real deployments remain a mystery.

Let’s also do the economics. The revenue for $BABY  tokens right now mainly depends on continually minting new tokens to subsidize. If there isn’t external real profit flowing back, and if internal holdings keep getting released, the resulting sell pressure will absolutely cause a severe shock to the token price.

Besides, we all know Bitcoin mainnet’s slow throughput limits. When large numbers of retail users come in to do small deposits and unlocks, UTXOs will inevitably get fragmented all over the place. Once the chain becomes congested, miner fees will skyrocket on the spot. The interest you earn might not even cover the transaction fees.

To be fair, Babylon adding an interest-bearing mechanic to BTC without hard forks is indeed a hardcore innovation. But given the current complex architecture, charging in blindly isn’t the right move. Instead of listening to the community’s trading calls, it’s better to keep a close watch on the mainnet’s true capital accumulation and see whether withdrawals will be smooth later on. No matter how loudly it’s hyped, it can’t beat time giving you the real answers.

Global Stock Market Bonanza Hits New High! BTC $64,228 Left in the Cold—This Could Get Dangerous

💡 Bearish Alert: The global market’s “money-pulling” effect is obvious. Traditional capital is abandoning the crypto market and rotating into the U.S. stock market. Selling pressure on BTC and ETH is increasing in the short term.

BTC at $64,228 is up only 0.66% in 24h; ETH at $1,873.17 is up just 0.23% in 24h. Big Brother Bitcoin clearly hasn’t captured any of the global asset rally’s upside. The transmission chain is crystal clear: global stock markets keep printing record highs → steady institutions and hot money flock into traditional equities to take profits → the crypto market suffers a serious “liquidity blood drain” → BTC and ETH buy-side demand shrinks sharply → prices remain under continuous pressure.

In one sentence
Global stock markets hit record highs across the board. Traditional funds are疯狂ly pulling out of crypto, and BTC and ETH are being effectively sidelined, facing a slow grind lower.

What’s going on
Brothers, the chart really feels frustratingly tight. To put it plainly: lately global stock markets have been going wild and constantly breaking new highs. But looking back at our crypto world: BTC is now $64,228—up only a pathetic 0.66% in a day; ETH is $1,873.17—up just 0.23% in a day, basically stagnant like dead water.

The derivatives data disclosed by CoinDesk reveals the truth: right now the options and futures markets for BTC and ETH are as cold as an icebox, with extremely thin trading. Where did the hot money go? It all ran to trade those unknown small altcoins. Traders think Big Brother Bitcoin can’t bounce much in the short term, so they withdraw capital and concentrate their firepower on high-leverage bets in small coins. This behavior—institutions and large players siphoning liquidity from the leaders—is a textbook example of limited funds cutting each other up. Bitcoin’s push upward lacks strength and, forced to, can only go searching for support below.

Market impact
- Short term: The illusion of “altcoin season” is misleading retail investors. Instead of rotating to lift BTC and ETH, funds are aggressively pumping small coins, showing that the main players don’t dare to catch the broad market at high levels. Once the hype in small coins fades, leverage cascade liquidations will wipe out the last protection, and BTC won’t even have the “final fig leaf.” The liquidity drain caused by capital leaving will lead to the broader market accelerating its drop.
- Medium term: It’s absolutely not a good sign that the crypto market has decoupled from the global stock market. If U.S. stocks keep setting new highs while BTC lags, it means institutions have already downgraded crypto assets in their asset allocation. Without incoming external incremental capital, the medium-term broader market will likely continue the pattern of drifting lower—crushing the fantasy of “U.S. stocks’ new highs driving crypto.”

My take
Honestly, at this level I’m clearly bearish—don’t catch falling knives. BTC can’t even hold $64,228. The strong support below is directly the $60,000 round-number level. If U.S. stocks keep printing new highs tonight and BTC is still pretending to be dead, a break of $62,000 could happen in minutes. Then the liquidation orders in the derivatives market will smash through this “floor”/base. Until you see spot volume and a firm hold above $66,000, any rebound is an opportunity for you to reduce exposure—don’t act as the bag-holder. ETH is even weaker: you can’t even see the shadow of an independent move. It’s just going to suffer alongside Big Brother.

老铁们，这盘面看着真的憋屈。说白了，最近全球股市涨疯了，一直在刷历史新高。但回头看看咱们币圈，BTC现在报 $64,228，一天就涨了可怜的0.66%；ETH报 $1,873.17，一天才0.23%，基本就是横着死水一滩。

讲真，现在这位置我是明确看空的，别去接飞刀。BTC连 $64,228 都站不稳，下方的强支撑位直接看 $60,000 整数关口。如果美股今晚继续创新高而BTC还在装死，破位 $62,000 就是分分钟的事，到时候衍生品市场的爆仓单会把这个底盘砸穿。在看到放量站稳 $66,000 之前，任何反弹都是给你减仓的机会，别去当接盘侠。ETH更弱，连独立行情的影子都看不到，跟着大饼一起吃土。

Today BTC ranged from 63,582 to 64,512, and closed at 64,044, up 0.22%. It looks green, but when you break it down, it’s just sideways grinding—full-day amplitude is under 1.5%. Trading volume is 8.43B, and the funding rate is 0.0037% slightly positive, but it can’t support a trend at all.

ETH is even worse: around 1,868, down 0.22%, with the fee rate nearly zero. XRP is directly -1.69%, leading among the majors. BNB is relatively strong—around 597, up 0.83%—but volume is only 0.3B, so it can’t lift the whole market.

The whole-day recap in one line: bulls and bears have no momentum. In the early session it tried to push above 64,500 but got pushed back; in the afternoon it probed near 63,580 and someone stepped in to buy. It’s the classic tug-of-war around the pivot: the PP is at 63,960, and the current price is just hovering right above it.

Clear direction:
1. The night session is slightly bullish, but the room is very limited. If it holds above 64,000, first look at the 64,300–64,600 zone. The daily sell point at 64,629 is the ceiling. Only if it breaks through do we talk about a trend—if it can’t, it’s just a fake breakout.
2. Key defense is 63,580–63,400. If that level breaks and the daily buy point at 63,406 is lost, the downside risk opens straight to around 63,000—don’t fantasize about some deep V.
3. ETH follows BTC. 1,850 is the hard support, while resistance is clear near 1,885. An independent setup for ETH is basically unlikely tonight.

Retail traders love to gamble on direction in these narrow-range bearish days, but the result is that trading fees get fed to market makers. The data has already said it plainly: it’s not a one-way day—it’s a consolidation-and-consumption day.

The night-session plan is simple—above 64,000 you can ride the long-side momentum for a rebound, with the target staying below 64,600. If 63,400 breaks, don’t force it—admit the drop first, then discuss opportunity. If the next day continues to grind the pivot with shrinking volume, most likely this same script repeats; wait for volume expansion to choose a direction.

Don’t treat the sideways action as “accumulating energy.” A lot of the time it’s simply because nobody wants to take responsibility for a direction.

🎯 Before going to bed, I set a limit order to sell part of my ETH.

Here’s why.

Yes, I could have sat there all night and tried to catch the perfect peak.

But I’ve figured out one thing a long time ago.

The desire to sell perfectly more often gets in the way of making money than it helps.

So I placed the order in advance.

If during the night ETH rises to my target, great—part of the position will close automatically.

If it doesn’t reach it, that’s okay too.

I don’t have to guess every market move.

For me, it matters much more to know in advance what I’m going to do in either of the two scenarios.

That’s exactly why I’m coming back to one rule more and more often:

Use market psychology, not fight it.

Most trading mistakes don’t happen because of bad analysis.

They happen when a pre-made plan gets changed under the influence of fear or greed.

And do you leave limit orders overnight, or do you prefer to do everything manually?

title: The Billionaire Mindset: Why Hope Is the First Investment.
subTitle:
Can an ordinary person become a billionaire?
The answer is yes—but not because becoming a billionaire is easy or guaranteed. Every billionaire in history was once an ordinary person with a dream, an idea, or a goal. What separated many of them from others was not where they started, but how they thought, learned, adapted, and persevered.
Hope is where every extraordinary journey begins.
Every Giant Was Once Small
Every successful business started with a single idea.
Every famous entrepreneur had a first customer.
Every investor made a first investment.
No one is born at the finish line. Success is built one step at a time.
Whether your dream is to build a company, become a successful investor, or create something that changes the world, your current situation does not have to define your future.
Hope Creates Action
Hope alone will not make you wealthy.
But without hope, many people never take the first step.
Hope encourages people to:
Learn new skills.Start a business.Save and invest.Take calculated risks.Keep moving after failure.
Action transforms hope into progress.
Wealth Begins in the Mind
Many people believe wealth starts with money.
In reality, wealth often begins with a mindset.
People who build extraordinary success usually develop habits such as:
Reading and learning every day.Solving problems for others.Managing money wisely.Being patient with long-term goals.Never stopping when life becomes difficult.
These habits create opportunities over time.
Learn More Than You Earn
Knowledge is one of the few investments that nobody can take away from you.
Whether you study technology, finance, artificial intelligence, entrepreneurship, blockchain, or another field, every new skill increases your ability to create value.
The more value you create for others, the more opportunities you may have to build wealth.
Failure Is Part of Success
Many people only see successful entrepreneurs after they become famous.
What they don't see are the failures, mistakes, sleepless nights, and difficult decisions that came before success.
Failure is not the opposite of success—it is often one of its greatest teachers.
Every setback can become a lesson that prepares you for a better opportunity.
Build, Don't Chase
Many people chase money.
Successful people often focus on building something valuable.
They build:
Businesses.Products.Communities.Technology.Solutions to real-world problems.
Money often follows value.
Billionaires Think Long-Term
One common characteristic shared by many successful entrepreneurs is patience.
They understand that meaningful success usually takes years—not days or weeks.
Instead of asking, "How can I become rich this month?" they ask, "What can I build over the next ten years?"
Long-term thinking often leads to stronger decisions.
Your Background Is Not Your Destiny
Some of the world's most successful people grew up with very little.
They faced rejection, financial struggles, and countless obstacles.
What made the difference was their willingness to keep learning, improving, and believing that tomorrow could be better than today.
Your circumstances may influence your starting point, but they do not have to determine your destination.
Success Means More Than Money
While becoming a billionaire is an extraordinary achievement, true success is about more than the number in a bank account.
It includes:
Creating opportunities for others.Making a positive impact.Building something meaningful.Living with purpose and integrity.
Money is a tool, but character is what gives success lasting value.
Conclusion
Can you become a billionaire?
No one can promise that outcome. Many hardworking, talented people never reach that level of wealth, and there is no guaranteed path.
What is possible is becoming more knowledgeable, more disciplined, more resilient, and more capable than you are today. Those qualities increase your chances of creating meaningful success, whatever form it takes.
Never let your current circumstances convince you that your future is already written.
Dream boldly. Learn continuously. Work consistently. Stay humble.
The greatest investment you will ever make is not in a stock, a cryptocurrency, or a business—it is in yourself. Every remarkable journey begins with one decision: to believe that a better future is worth building. #ETH #BNB_Market_Update #BTC $BTCDOM

Last time I repaid an Aave v4 loan on the public testnet. I refreshed my BTC wallet three times, but the balance didn’t move. My first reaction was that I’d clicked the wrong network again—just a reflex from on-chain users.

After watching the whole flow, I finally understood: “Repayment successful” only means the debt is zero; it doesn’t mean the native BTC has already come home. Once the vault exits the Aave position, only then does TBV for @babylonlabs_io  transfer into the Bitcoin side’s Claim, Assert, challenge window, and Payout. The testnet challenge period is 432 BTC blocks, usually close to 3 days. It’s not a platform- or compliance-related coin review; it’s because Bitcoin can’t read the Ethereum state. The protocol must leave time for an incorrect claim to be overturned.

This is exactly what makes TBV more appealing than custodial lending: $BTC stays locked in Taproot UTXOs. It isn’t wrapped into a token, and it doesn’t end up in anyone’s liquidity pool. title: $2.4 Billion Traded, ETH Moved 1.65%: What The Most-Searched Coins Are Not Telling You
subTitle:
$2.4 billion of ETH traded on Binance spot over the last seven days. Over that same window, price moved 1.65%.

Hold those two numbers next to each other, because they explain almost everything about the tape right now — and they explain why the "most searched coins" list is about to cost people money.

THE ABSORPTION PROBLEM

$ETH is trading at 1,919.75. Over 7 days it has ranged 1,822.06 to 1,936.99 and closed up 1.65%. In the last 24 hours it added 2.15% on $428.8 million of turnover, high 1,928.00, low 1,855.50.

That is a lot of money moving for very little distance covered. When turnover is huge and net movement is small at the top of a range, it usually means supply is meeting demand there. Buyers are showing up, and someone is filling them.

The levels make the same point:

- 1,932.49 has rejected price 8 separate times on the 1H. That is the ceiling.
- Above it: 1,975.53, then the 30-day high at 1,981.24.
- 1,857.10 has held 15 touches. That is the floor that matters.
- The 1H volume point of control sits at 1,875.78 — the price where most of the recent business was done.

Momentum is stretched into that ceiling. 1H RSI is 76.2 and volume is running 2.1x its average. On the 4H, RSI is 66.2 with resistance at 1,948.24. On the daily, RSI is only 56.8 and the 200 EMA is still overhead at 2,146.15 — price has been below it for the whole 30-day range of 1,713.44 to 1,981.24.

So the higher timeframe has not turned. The lower timeframe is overbought. Those two facts together are why chasing here is expensive.

Two setups are actually tradeable. An hourly close above 1,932.49 that then holds a retest gives you a level to work against. A flush into 1,857.10 that gets defended gives you the other side. Everything between 1,857 and 1,932 is noise you pay for.

WHAT THE SEARCH LIST IS ACTUALLY TELLING YOU

Binance Square's most-searched coins over 6H read: ETH, VANRY, PSG, ONE, PORTO, IOST, SENT, ORDI, CRCLB, STRAX. Fear & Greed sits at 39 — Fear.

Search interest is a lagging indicator. People search a ticker after it has already moved. That is the whole trap.

$HFT is the clearest example on the board today. It is up 85.67% in 24 hours. It is up 109.86% over 7 days, having run from 0.006692 to a high of 0.020767 — a 210% move off the weekly low.

Now the number nobody checks: total 7-day turnover in HFT is roughly $28 million. Total 30-day turnover is about $30 million. Nearly all of its lifetime-recent volume happened in the last day.

ETH does more turnover than HFT's entire month in about ninety minutes.

That is not an argument that HFT goes down. It is an argument about exit liquidity. In a book that thin, your position size is the market. The move that took it up on $17 million can take it back down on far less, and you will not get the fill you are imagining.

$VANRY sits second on the search list at 0.003582, up 4.58% in 24h on $5.7 million of turnover, ranging 0.003236 to 0.004215. Same structural issue: high attention, thin book.

For context, BTC did $809.4 million in 24 hours to move 0.53%.

HOW TO USE THIS

The searched names are where the attention is. The liquid names are where you can actually get out. Those are rarely the same list, and the gap between them is where most retail losses live.

If you want the volatility, size it as a lottery ticket and accept you may not exit cleanly. If you want a position you can manage, ETH is giving you defined lines: 1,932.49 above, 1,857.10 below, and no reason to be involved in between.

Fear at 39 with price near range highs and momentum overbought is not a "back up the truck" signal. It is a "wait for the level" signal.

WHAT WOULD CHANGE THIS

An hourly close above 1,932.49 that holds on retest flips the near-term structure and puts 1,975.53 and 1,981.24 in play. A loss of 1,857.10 puts 1,849.20 and then the daily support shelf back on the table. Until one of those happens, the range is the range.

Which one are you positioned for — the reclaim above 1,932, or the flush into 1,857?

Analysis, not financial advice. All levels taken from live Binance klines at the time of writing.

title: Most Searched vs Most Moved: ETH at 1,857, UNI Breaking Out, and the Token Up 189% With Nothing Underneath It
subTitle:
One token on Binance is up 189% in seven days. It is not in the top ten most-searched list. Everything you need to know about how retail positions itself is in that one sentence.

Here is what the tape actually says right now — every number below is read from live Binance klines, not from a narrative.

THE MACRO SETUP

July ADP private payrolls came in at +44K against +75K expected — a bad miss. The US ISM Services Index printed 54.1, still expansionary. So: hiring is stalling while services hold up. That combination pulls rate-cut expectations forward, which is normally a tailwind for risk.

The market is not trading it that way. The Fear & Greed Index reads 39 — Fear. BTC is at 64,605, up just 1.0% over seven days and still 19% below where it traded 90 days ago. That is not a market front-running easy money. That is a market waiting.

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SEARCHING (AND WHY IT IS A TRAP)

Binance's Most Searched Coins over the last 6 hours: ETH, VANRY, PSG, ONE, PORTO, IOST, SENT, ORDI.

Search interest is a lagging indicator. It tells you what already moved, not what is about to. Two examples from that exact list:

VANRY — up 5.8% on the day, which is why it is being searched. Zoom out: down 16.9% over 7 days and down 51.9% over 30 days. It also printed 0.004215 earlier today and now trades 0.003595 — 14.7% off its own high, on the same day people started looking it up.

ORDI — 3.409, down 33.6% over 90 days, and the USDT pair turned over roughly $1.6M in 24 hours. Thin. In a book that size, your own exit is the thing that moves the price against you.

Being on the searched list is not a thesis. It is a crowd.

$ETH — THE LEVEL THAT DECIDES IT

The most-searched coin is also the least exciting one on the chart, and that is the point.

ETH trades at 1,892.7, up 1.0% in 24 hours but down 0.9% over seven days. It is compressed. The hourly structure is clean:

- Support: 1,857.2, and this level has been touched 14 separate times. That is not noise, that is a floor the market keeps agreeing on.
- Resistance: 1,932.5 — 8 touches. Above that, 1,948.2 on the 4h and then 1,981.2.

So the map is simple. Holding 1,857 keeps the compression bullish and 1,932 is the trigger; clearing it opens 1,948 then 1,981. Losing 1,857 on a closing basis puts 1,849 and then 1,825 in play. ETH sits at 44% of its 4h range — genuinely mid-book, which is why it is chopping.

$UNI — THE BREAKOUT NOBODY IS SEARCHING

UNI is at 4.173, up 7.3% on the day and up 31.1% over 30 days. It closed at, effectively, the high of the day: today's high is 4.174.

- Support: 3.832 with 6 touches, then 3.742 with 5.
- Resistance: 4.285 on the hourly, then 4.583 on the daily.
- Daily RSI is 60.1 — trending, not stretched. That is the difference between this and the vertical names.

A move that has already done 31% in a month with a 60 RSI and structure underneath it is a different animal from a move that has done 189% in a week with an RSI of 82. One has a stop you can actually define. The other does not.

$HEI — THE 189% AND WHAT IS UNDERNEATH IT

HEI trades at 0.2353, up 189% over seven days and up roughly 124% in 24 hours. Hourly volume ran about 16x its average on the way up.

Now the part that matters:

- It printed 0.2574 earlier today and is 8.6% below that already.
- Daily RSI: 82.3.
- The hourly volume point of control — where the coin genuinely changed hands — is 0.1838, about 22% below spot.
- The first support level with repeat touches is 0.0908, roughly 61% below spot.

Between 0.1838 and 0.0908 there is essentially no structure. That gap is not a prediction of a crash; it is a statement about what the chart can and cannot do for you. In an air gap there is no level for a stop to rest on and no shelf for a bounce to form on. Position size is the only risk control that still functions.

HFT tells the same story from one step further along: +106% in seven days, and already 10.5% under its own high from today.

WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE READ

- ETH closing an hourly candle above 1,932.5 with volume: the compression resolves up and the searched-coin crowd is, for once, early.
- ETH losing 1,857.2 on a close: 1,849 then 1,825, and the whole alt complex gets heavier.
- HEI reclaiming and holding 0.2574: the move is not done and the volume POC becomes the pullback target instead of the destination.
- HEI losing 0.1838: the air gap below is live and there is nothing structural until 0.0908.
- Fear & Greed climbing out of the 30s while BTC holds 63,469 (19 hourly touches): rotation broadens instead of narrowing into micro-caps.

THE HONEST SUMMARY

Vertical micro-cap moves while the sentiment index reads Fear is capital rotating inside a flat market, not new money entering one. Rotations are tradeable. They are also short. The names with defined structure — ETH at 1,857/1,932, UNI at 3.832/4.285 — are where you can be wrong cheaply. The names up 189% in a week are where being wrong is expensive, because the chart has not built anywhere to be wrong.

The most useful trade this hour might be the one you do not take.

Which one are you actually watching — the 189% mover, or the coin sitting quietly at 1,892 with 14 touches under it?

Analysis, not financial advice. All levels and percentages read from live Binance market data at time of writing.

⚠️ What if Ethereum scarcity became stronger… but at the expense of the validators that protect the network?

The proposed EIP-8363 suggests burning an increasing portion of validator rewards as the staked Ethereum ratio rises, with the goal of curbing supply inflation and preventing massive amounts from concentrating among major staking entities. However, it is still a draft for discussion; it has not been adopted or given a timeline for implementation.

In theory, reducing issuance could support ETH scarcity in the long run. But lower staking yields may pressure independent validators, and reprice staking and liquidity products within the DeFi ecosystem. Here is the disagreement: does this proposal protect the network’s decentralization, or does it push high-cost operators to exit and leave the field to large entities? 🔥

Price-wise, the news is not an immediate catalyst, because it does not change network rules currently. Its real impact will only show up if it moves toward adoption and the market begins to price in its effect on issuance, staking yields, and network security.

A balanced trader watches how price interacts with trading volume, and doesn’t chase the move because of a technical draft that is still controversial. 📊

【Whales are quietly accumulating— but are you really bold enough to follow?】

Today I took a look at on-chain data and found an interesting signal:

CryptoQuant just released a report saying that large holders of BTC, ETH, and XRP have recently been quietly adding positions while the market is weak. The Fear & Greed Index is only 27, and the whole朋友圈 (circle of friends) is full of cries of despair—but the whales are actually taking orders.

Honestly, when I see a signal like this, my first reaction isn’t excitement—it’s caution.

The logic behind what big players and retail investors do is completely different. They have enough liquidity stress-testing capability. If the market drops, they can hold through it—can retail investors do the same? That’s why whenever this kind of data comes out saying “whales are accumulating,” I always ask a more fundamental question—

**Does the business logic actually hold up in practice?**

When institutions accumulate near the end of a bear market, it’s essentially a risk-management move. What they want is diversified allocation of assets. If it drops by half, they buy again—at odds that look much better than chasing after the highs. But that’s an institutional playbook, not a retail playbook.

If retail investors copy the assignment, they’ll most likely end up guarding a position at the high.

What I’m watching is ETH’s performance within the 1819 to 1962 range. How long has it been moving sideways here? If it breaks upward, is the volume enough? If it gets dumped downward, are the whales really putting up real money—or did they just put on a demonstration to lure you in?

The weekly average FNG is only 26, but ETH has already quietly rebounded by 2 points this week. This kind of divergence has appeared before as a bottom signal—I admit that. But I’ve been burned by too many “bottom signals,” so now I only observe and don’t make claims.

BTC’s market share of 56.6% remains high, suggesting that capital is still clumped in BTC. For ETH to truly kick off, we need to see this share drop and funds rotate into other sectors.

Where I’m stuck is this: technical signals have appeared, but I still don’t dare to conclude that this bounce is guaranteed. We’ll need volume to provide the answer.

Now, massive liquidations are happening in stock accounts. A lot of this money was supposed to flow into crypto. Market impact

【如果ETH今晚跌到1700，牌桌上谁先扛不住？】

这不是算命，是推演。

现在$ 1905附近横着，短期方向就在1819到1962之间选。这两个点位有意思——1819是支撑，1962是压力。多头盯着1819，空头盯着1962，谁先破谁就赢。

先说结构。日线看，从高点下来这一段，低点一个比一个低，高点也在往下走——典型的下降通道。但注意一个细节：最近这波下跌，成交量明显比前面萎缩了。卖的人少了，这是好事还是坏事？好事是抛压不重，坏事是没有抄底资金进来。两种解读都行，这就是市场。

再说一个信号。恐惧指数FNG现在25，历史低位，但ETH在这里没继续破底，反而稳住了。这种背离我见过不止一次——2019年见过，2022年也见过。市场情绪最绝望的时候，往往是聪明钱进场的时候。这不是说现在一定见底，是说这个位置值得观察。

鲸鱼在积累，CryptoQuant的数据摆在那儿。大户在捡筹码，散户在割肉，这剧本我太熟了。但问题来了——鲸鱼买了不代表马上拉，他们可能横着吃几个月，可能借利好出货，也可能真的看好。这里面的门道，不是散户能猜透的。

估值方面，ETH从高点跌了61%，不算最惨的时候，但也不便宜。DeFi生态还在，质押还在，项目方还在开发——基本面没有根本性恶化。但估值低不代表不跌，市场情绪来了，该跌还是跌。

多空谁在意什么？多头怕破1819，那破了就是新低，情绪会崩一波。空头怕突1962，突了就是短期趋势反转，可能引来跟风盘。两边都在等，等成交量放大，等信号确认。

至于商业逻辑——现在ETH生态里，质押收益率年化4%左右，对机构资金有吸引力，但不够。对散户来说，这点收益cover不住波动风险。市场现在不是缺逻辑，是缺信心。信心这东西，不是K线能画出来的。

哪个方向先行？我倾向于短期向下试探1819的支撑，然后看能不能守住。守住了，多头才有故事讲。守不住，那就不是试盘，是真破位。

这个判断可能被推翻——如果比特币突然拉升或者有实质性利好，ETH可能直接突1962，不给你反应时间。

说真的，现在这行情，看对了是运气，看错了是正常。我只能说，我更愿意在这个位置观察，而不是重仓押注。

EIP-8361 Proposal Triggers Vibration in the LSD Sector🔥

A new Ethereum proposal, EIP-8361, suggests that when the staking ratio reaches 50%, validator rewards should drop directly to zero. The news instantly ignited panic selling across the LSD sector: $LDO  saw a 16.3% one-day plunge, $ETHFI  followed down 9.6%, and the entire liquid staking derivative (LSD) market led the downturn.

The core logic is simple: the higher the staking ratio, the lower the rewards—meaning the expected returns for holding LST tokens get significantly compressed. As leading LSD protocols, Lido and ether.fi are naturally the first to be hit.

But from another angle, this is only the proposal stage, and there’s still a long community debate before anything is actually implemented. Ethereum’s core developers have historically been cautious about making big cuts to validator rewards, and the final version will very likely be adjusted. So the short-term sell-off driven by sentiment may be an overreaction.

Still, the long-term logic of the LSD sector is definitely worth re-examining—when Ethereum’s own staking yield is suppressed, how much room is left for value capture in the middle layer? That might be the more important question to think about.

The market immediately voted with its feet—LDO plunged 16.3% in a single day, ETHFI fell 9.6%, and the entire LSD sector came under collective pressure.

Simply put, this EIP is essentially: “Stop issuing wages once competition is cranked up to the max.” Once the staking ratio approaches 50%, the marginal收益 of new validators drops to zero. That means:

- LSD protocols like Lido and ether.fi lose their incentive to attract new deposits
- The yield curve of existing stETH and weETH faces a structural downward shift
- Funds may flow out of LSD, potentially re-entering spot ETH or other DeFi sectors

Of course, the proposal is still in the early discussion stage, and there’s a long way to go before any real implementation. But in crypto markets, the logic is always “expectations first”—prices have already priced in the worst-case scenario ahead of time.

In the short term, sentiment in the LSD sector will likely remain under pressure. However, whether it will evolve in the mid-to-long term into a “self-rescue proposal modification” or be rejected is something worth watching closely through ongoing on-chain governance developments.

The harder regulators push deleveraging in traditional markets, the more obvious the capital overflow effect becomes. 【Whales are secretly accumulating—are you in or out?】

Within 48 hours, two interesting pieces of news came together: big players are accumulating ETH while prices are low, and CryptoQuant directly said, “The bear market is nearing its end.” On the other hand, global stock markets have hit historical highs, yet the crypto market is clearly lagging behind.

When these two signals collide, it’s hard not to read between the lines.

Here’s my experience from putting this into practice: when do big players accumulate in large amounts? Not when the bull market is topping out—it's when the market is at its most desperate. Retail investors panic-sell and exit, while smart money moves in to pick up bargains. ETH has fallen 61% from its peak; at this level, the risk has been significantly released for patient capital.

Some will say: crypto lagging stocks means there’s no play. But flip the perspective—stocks are already at high levels, while ETH is still on “floor price.” That, in turn, could be the opportunity. Capital always rotates; no market can keep outshining all others forever.

So what does this mean in practical terms? Who will be affected?

If you’re already holding a position, selling at a loss right now is handing bloodied shares to the big players. If you’re in cash, chasing in at this level won’t cost you that much. But the key isn’t predicting short-term upside or downside—it’s figuring out where the money is going.

Institutions look at business logic. ETH staked yields an annualized 3%-5%. On the ecosystem side, you have DeFi, Layer 2, and real users actively using it. The fundamentals haven’t fallen apart—if the price is down this much, it’s more a problem of sentiment and liquidity.

I’m not saying it must surge right now. The market can always drop again. Big players accumulating is just a signal, not a guarantee. But probabilistically, this is worth taking seriously.

【鲸鱼在偷偷吸筹，你跟不跟？】

48小时内看到两条有意思的消息放在一起：大户们在趁低积累ETH、CryptoQuant直接说"熊市接近尾声"；另一边，全球股市创下历史新高，币圈却明显落后。

这两个信号碰一块儿，意味深长。

我实操下来的经验：大户什么时候会大量积累？不是牛市冲顶的时候，是市场最绝望的时候。，散户割肉离场，聪明钱进场捡货。ETH从高点跌了61%，这个位置对于有耐心的资金来说，风险已经大幅释放。

有人会说，币圈落后股市说明没戏。但换个角度想，股市已经高位，ETH还在地板价，这反而可能是机会。资金从来都是轮动的，没有哪个市场能一直独涨。

那这件事落到实处意味着什么？谁会受影响？

如果你有仓位，现在割肉就是在把带血的筹码交给大户。如果你空仓，这个位置追进去成本也不高。但关键不是预测短期涨跌，是看清楚资金在往哪儿走。

机构进场看的是商业逻辑。ETH质押年化3%-5%，生态上有DeFi、有Layer2、有真实用户在用。基本面没崩，价格跌成这样，更多是情绪和流动性的问题。

我不是说现在必涨，市场永远可能再跌。大户积累只是信号，不是保证。但从概率上讲，这里值得认真看。

Moscow, 4 August -- Russian President Vladimir Putin signed on Tuesday the first law in Russia that establishes a comprehensive regulatory framework for the trading of digital currencies and digital rights in the country.
The document sets out rules for cryptocurrency trading platforms, digital asset custody services, and market participants, and also lays down conditions for investors wishing to buy cryptocurrencies.
The legislation regulates the processes of licensing, accounting, custody, and storage of digital currencies and foreign digital instruments. It also regulates cryptocurrency mining, the issuance and trading of digital rights, and the activities of operators of information systems that issue digital financial assets.
In addition, the law sets standards for providers of digital currency exchange services, digital asset custody services, brokers, management companies, trading organizers, and clearing houses.
Under the law, only institutions listed in a special government register will be allowed to carry out digital currency exchange activities after 1 July 2027. The minimum amount of their own funds (capital) must not be less than 15 million rubles (about USD 186,000). These entities will also be required to join a self-regulatory body in the financial market.
